chain_trace.break_detail: Two independent breaks. (1) CONTRACT link: the judged violation (list-membership immediacy) has no contract anchor — constraint_id empty, invariant covers only collections+get (satisfied). (2) SCRIPT link: the membership check is incompatible with the documented and source-confirmed response shape ([{"name":...}]), so 'in list: False' is the inevitable client-side result regardless of server state; moreover the raw list body was not captured, so the log contains zero evidence that the server omitted the collection. Source shows list/get/exists all read the same in-memory collections map that create populates before returning 200, so a genuine server-side invisibility is not possible on this code path.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: PUT /collections/{name} handler (src/actix/api/collections_api.rs:112-135) -> Dispatcher::submit_collection_meta_op (lib/storage/src/dispatcher.rs:72; for CreateCollection it registers awaiters and do_sync_nodes=true, code comment at :157-165: 'callers expect the updated collection config to be visible on every peer on return') -> Toc::perform_collection_meta_op (collection_meta_ops.rs:37-73) -> Toc::create_collection -> self.collections.write().await.insert(name, ...) (create_collection.rs:241-244). The list backend (do_list_collections, src/common/collections.rs:87) reads the exact same RwLock map via all_collections (toc/mod.rs:338-354). Therefore once create returns 200 the collection name is necessarily present in the list source; immediate GET green and exists=true in the same log read the same map and corroborate this.
source_grounding.note: by_design_in_source: create-then-list visibility holds by construction (single shared map; handler awaits consensus apply + insert before responding 200). No code path exists for the claimed server-side 'absent from list immediately after create 200'.
